# MaybeWe — Solo Traveler Matching & Curated Trip Discovery Platform

> MaybeWe is India's dedicated solo traveler matching and trip discovery platform. It pairs solo explorers heading to the same destinations across India during overlapping travel dates, supported by biometric on-device trust verification, mutual safety barriers, curated local place discovery, and collaborative hangout planning.

## Core Capabilities

- **Curated Solo Traveler Matching**: Date-overlap algorithm pairing travelers heading to top Indian destinations (Goa, Manali, Jaipur, Kashmir, Kerala, Ladakh, Varanasi, Udaipur, and beyond) with compatibility scoring.
- **Biometric Trust & Safety**: On-device face verification using MediaPipe BlazeFace / ML Kit. Never stores or leaks biometrics to third-party clouds.
- **In-Chat Safety Scanner**: Automatic client-side detection of sensitive information (unsolicited phone numbers, external handles, links) to safeguard travelers before trust is established.
- **Trip Planner Plus & INR Budget Intelligence**: Day-by-day itinerary planning with scheduling conflict detection, automated daily budget allocations in Indian Rupees (₹), and affordable alternatives.
- **Place Discovery**: 13 curated categories (Cafes, Restaurants, Stays, Activities, Attractions, Experiences, Adventure, Culture, Luxury, Photography, Nature, Nightlife, Shopping) localized for India.
- **Hangout Planning & Group Circles**: Collaborative meetups with smart place suggestions, member voting, and seamless export into trip itineraries.
- **Real-Time Travel Presence**: Mutual-opt-in temporary live location sharing with precise vs approximate privacy modes and automatic time expirations.

## Key Public Routes

- `/`: Primary application hub, trip discovery feed, and travel companion suggestions.
- `/discovery`: Curated destination guides, trending spots, and hidden gems across India.
- `/trips`: Trip planner, day-by-day scheduling, packing checklist, and INR expense tracker.
- `/matches`: Verified travel connections, pending requests, and hangout groups.
- `/guidelines`: Community safety principles, verification rules, and conduct policies.
- `/welcome`: Introduction to MaybeWe community and onboarding.
- `/signup`: Verified traveler registration for adults 18+.
- `/login`: Secure authentication portal.

## Community & Safety Standards

- **Verified Identity**: All active connections require a verified selfie check.
- **Zero Self-Verification**: Trust decisions are cryptographically enforced and cannot be manipulated from the client.
- **Mutual Safety Barrier**: Blocking any user instantly creates a bilateral barrier across chat, location, and discovery.

## Technology Stack

- **Client**: Expo (React Native Web & Mobile), Expo Router, Manrope Typography.
- **Design System**: Warm Champagne Pearl (`#FFFDFC`, `#E7D3B5`, `#171817`, `#756345`).
- **Backend & Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, Realtime Publications).
- **Deployment**: Vercel Serverless & Global Edge CDN.
